scoped_dependencies.relation: Only the interpretation of the exact Choi objective as the complete contraction coefficient uses N402; the inverse-probability identity is an algebraic Choi calculation.

failure: Failure: No polynomial-in-n qubit algorithm follows from an O(|G||S|) computation when |G|=4^n; no uniform small-time spectral-gap implication or general mixing improvement is claimed.
interface: Interface: Exact orthogonal-unitary error probabilities or a fixed finite projective-Weyl jump presentation with positive rates; noise law and group are supplied.
